fightOffers.pitch: A fair fight on paper. The kind careers are made of.

fighter.statement: People keep telling me what I can’t do. I’m tired of hearing it. I don’t need you to believe in me. I need you to train me.
fighter.ceilingRead: If even half of what you think you’re seeing is real, he’s special.

fighter.statement: I’ve been overlooked my whole life. I’m used to it. It just makes me work. People keep telling me what I can’t do. I’m tired of hearing it.
fighter.ceilingRead: Handled right, he could surprise some people down the line.

fighter.statement: I dont care how hard you push me. I wont break. I aint got no big amature record but I can fight, I know that much.
